messages.subject: Fwd: Error in BioGeoBEARS
parts:
Quick answer to a question, anonymized...


On XXX, X wrote:
Hello!

I am using your R package "BioGeoBEARS" in R studio and I have tried to run it for several hours and have been unsuccessful. The error code I keep receiving is:

FATAL ERROR in inputs: 1 tree tips are not in the geographic ranges file.  These are:
Xxxxx_yyyyy  [this was a Genus_species name, which I have removed to anonymize it -- Nick]

I am not sure what this means, but I have spent hours trying to figure it out. I have attached my tree and geography spread, as well as the text file. 

Any help you can provide is awesome and would be much appreciated!

Thanks,
XXXX


 
---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Nick Matzke <mat...@nimbios.org>
Date: Sat, Mar 5, 2016 at 3:50 PM
Subject: Re: Error in BioGeoBEARS
To: XXXX


Hi XXXX,

So, your geography file has a list of species, and your newick file has a list of species.  These lists have to match *exactly*.  The error message is saying that you are missing a species in your geography file.

Cheers!
Nick
